place.name: Hochtann Mountain Pass
place.description: Hochtann Mountain Pass (German: Hochtannbergpass, 1,679 m (5,509 ft)) is a mountain pass in the Austrian Alps in the Bundesland of Vorarlberg. It connects Warth in the Lech Valley to the east with the valley of the Bregenzer Ach near Schoppernau to the west.
